articles.title: ZachXBT names French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa as suspected victim of $133 million crypto theft
articles.description: Blockchain sleuth ZachXBT says the French bank may have lost more than $133 million from crypto exchange accounts. Crypto.com confirms it has blocked funds linked to the theft.

articles.title: Elon Musk floats space data centers as Democratic sweep puts pressure on AI trade
articles.description: Texas election result raises fears of data centre restrictions, while Musk and Palihapitiya draw attention to the space economy.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley says it is among the first banks to tokenize real world assets
articles.description: The bank's announcement follows the launch of the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation’s Tokenization Service, or DTS, on Oct. 28.

articles.title: Zcash grants committee drops plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC to future mining rewards
articles.description: The committee withdrew its proposal after community backlash, leaving competing plans to cut off its funding or preserve the existing grants system.

articles.title: Bitcoin surges to $78,300 in V-shaped comeback as midterm election uncertainty fades
articles.description: BTC is steaming higher as U.S. midterm election uncertainty fades.

articles.title: Jack Dorsey's Block faces $764 million DOJ settlement as bitcoin profit plunges 50%
articles.description: The proposed agreement would resolve a federal anti-money-laundering investigation, while lower Cash App trading fees halved Block's quarterly bitcoin gross profit.

articles.title: U.S.-sanctioned Moscow Exchange to list bitcoin and Tether’s USDT in December
articles.description: Russia’s main bourse wants back the crypto trading Russians do abroad, and one of the coins it's listing is issued by a company that freezes wallets on the U.S. sanctions list.

articles.title: South Korea's ruling party wants to delay its crypto tax again
articles.description: South Korea's ruling party wants to delay crypto tax by about two years, as it waits for global tax-sharing rules and new digital assets law.

articles.title: Democrats surge toward Senate, House majorities, with crypto braced for new direction
articles.description: The dominance of Republicans in all three government branches has been broken by the midterms, and the industry will feel the result as Congress changes hands.

articles.title: Bitcoin briefly sinks to $75,700 as bets on a Democratic sweep rattle markets
articles.description: Stock futures and the dollar slid and Treasuries rallied as early U.S. midterm returns pointed to Democrats taking both chambers of Congress.

articles.title: Live updates: Rep. Garcia vows to investigate Trump after 'blue wave' defeats crypto election gamble
articles.description: Voters are choosing who will represent them in the House, Senate and state-wide seats.

articles.title: What voters said about their views on crypto
articles.description: A CoinDesk-commissioned poll from April sheds light on how voters — who aren't necessarily part of the crypto sector — view this industry.

articles.title: What happens if North Korea steals Wall Street's tokenized assets next
articles.description: The $6.3 billion Binance hack showed how quickly cryptocurrencies can disappear on blockchain rails. Tokenized securities may offer better recourse than crypto after a theft, but the markets around them can still break down when stress hits.

articles.title: CFTC gets into legal clash over stock perps after having cleared path for crypto version
articles.description: A group backed by Citadel Securities and other firms sued the U.S. derivatives regulator for opening a path for perps that it argued belong in the SEC's hands.

articles.title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against Trump-linked World Liberty Financial over UAE ties
articles.description: The Tron founder says World Liberty failed to disclose its UAE ties until months into his lawsuit over $45 million in WLFI tokens.

articles.title: South Korea's president says country needs a ‘cybersecurity czar’ following $6.3 billion Binance hack
articles.description: Lee Jae Myung said he wants a government-wide agency to tackle cyberattacks as AI raises security concerns across financial institutions and critical infrastructure.

articles.title: Amazon, Tesla and SpaceX join OKX–ICE tokenized stock objections as deadline looms
articles.description: Objections have reached 56 companies, with nearly 80% of the venture’s initial stock selection opting out.

articles.title: Stablecoin governance group behind OUSD sets out management fee, offers equity earning pool
articles.description: Governance group Open Standard will charge a 0.1 basis point management fee on payment volume, capped at at $0.01 per payment.

articles.title: CFTC clears perpetual futures on stocks, bringing crypto trading model to Wall Street
articles.description: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the move gives U.S. traders a regulated alternative to “offshore, and often unregulated, venues.”

articles.title: Binance's $6.3 billion hack began with a fake job interview, and a campaign 'built over many months'
articles.description: North Korea-linked attackers spent months compromising Binance employees and internal systems before exploiting its hot-wallet signing infrastructure through Ethereum's EIP-7702 mechanism.

articles.title: South Korea asks its biggest banks how a major crypto hack would hit them
articles.description: In its first such survey, the BOK also asked about a crypto price crash, losses at another firm, and each firm’s crypto teams, budgets and investments.

articles.title: CZ warns of more AI-driven hacks following Binance’s historic $6.3 billion heist
articles.description: While investigators found no evidence that AI agents laundered the stolen Binance funds, Zhao stressed that automated tools are lowering the barrier for complex breaches.

articles.title: LO:TECH raises $12 million to expand crypto trading into U.S. and Asia
articles.description: LO:TECH is betting on round-the-clock tokenized stock trading but didn’t say if it trades them now; a WFE study found stock exchanges still set prices.

articles.title: Binance net outflows reach $5.3 billion after record hack. CEO says recovery underway
articles.description: Nearly $11 billion left the exchange over 46 hours, although CEO Richard Teng said hourly deposits were beginning to exceed withdrawals.

articles.title: Bitcoin is breaking a midterm election pattern going back to 2014
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 3, 2026
